mayShare.description: May modify shareWith. True for personal list owners and group-collection members.

groupSlug.description: Group slug when scope is group; null for personal task lists.

shareWith.description: Owner map of JMAP id (username or groups/{slug}) to CalendarRights (same collection-ACL grants as calendars). Null when the list is not shared or the caller is not the owner. Recipients always see null. Epic #1915: a grant to a user who no longer shares a Team with the owner, or to a Team the owner left, is left out here and the share is hidden for the sharee too (admins included). Nothing is deleted: the share comes back when they share a Team again. On the sharee's side the collection drops out of lists and lookups and /changes reports it destroyed, then created when it returns; native CalDAV/CardDAV clients drop their local copy and sync it again. An open app or offline cache on the owner's side keeps a hidden sharee until its next fetch of this collection, because the owner's own collection did not change.

isSharee.description: True when this instance is an inbound ACL share (access 2 or 3), not the owner or group-collection member.
